Title: Rolling Balls Sea Race
Description:
Rolling Balls Sea Race - Play Online
Narrow tracks. Deep water. One wrong move and you're gone. Rolling Balls Sea Race is a fast-paced obstacle racing game built on Unity physics — roll to the finish, grab every coin, don't fall. Simple premise. Brutal execution.

How to Play Rolling Balls Sea Race
Pick a mode. Roll to the finish line without hitting the water. Collect coins along the track to unlock new balls, tail tracks, and sky packages. Race solo or go head-to-head against a second player on the same keyboard. Dozens of levels. One goal: cross that line first.

Controlling Your Ball
Single player uses W, A, S, D or Arrow Keys — your pick. Two-player mode splits the keyboard: Player 1 gets W, A, S, D, Player 2 gets the Arrow Keys. Controls snap tight. Physics do the rest. Edge too close? Into the water you go. These are Physics Games in the truest sense — momentum matters, every turn carries weight.

Coins, Unlocks, Progression
Every coin on the track counts. Grab enough and the unlock shop opens up — new ball skins, tail tracks, and sky packages waiting behind coin gates. No shortcuts here. Grind the levels, hit the coins, build your collection. Addictive rhythm. If the low-poly 3D style and coin-collecting loop pull you in, Golf Orbit runs a similar rewarding loop — skill pays off in currency every run.

Pro Tips for Staying Dry
Slow down on sharp corners — speed kills on elevated tracks. Hug the inside of turns. Don't chase coins near the edges early on; survive first, collect second. In 2-player mode, bump your opponent on wide sections — legal, chaotic, effective. Physics-curious players who love testing boundaries might also enjoy Playground Man! Ragdoll Show! for that same unpredictable engine energy. And if pure sandbox destruction scratches that itch, Melon Sandbox delivers zero rules and maximum chaos.

Key Features
Dual modes: Solo race or split-screen 2-player on one keyboard — instant couch competition.
Low-poly 3D visuals: Clean, lag-free look. Runs smooth on desktop and mobile browsers alike.
Coin unlocks: New balls, tail tracks, sky packages — all earned in-run, no paywalls.
Dozens of levels: Elevated tracks over water, realistic nature backdrops, escalating difficulty.
Unity engine: Real physics on every roll. Momentum, gravity, edge pressure — all calculated live.
Cross-platform: desktop browser, iOS, Android. No downloads. Click and play.
Instructions:
1 Player Mode

WASD / arrow keys = move

2 Players Mode

WASD = player 1 move
Arrow keys = player 2 move

Title: Italian Brainrot Find the Difference
Description:
Italian Brainrot: Find the Difference is a fast, funny, and bizarre puzzle game where absurdity meets sharp-eyed fun. Each of the 30 levels features two nearly identical images—but with small, sneaky changes hidden in plain sight.

Designed especially for kids, this game brings together cartoon chaos and visual brain-training in a way that’s goofy, creative, and totally unforgettable. You’re not just spotting differences—you’re diving into a wild universe full of absurd characters and hilarious scenes.

🧠 How It Works
30 handcrafted levels with detailed, funny illustrations
Each level has 5 differences to find
No timers, no pressure—perfect for kids and families
Play directly in-browser on mobile or desktop
🎭 Key Characters in the Italian Brainrot Universe
Tralalero Tralala
A three-legged shark always rocking bright Nike sneakers. Whether he's leaping through chaos or fighting with Bombardino Crocodilo, he's full of attitude and absurd energy.

Bombardino Crocodilo
A crocodile-headed creature with the body of a WWII bomber plane. He drops more confusion than bombs and makes every level feel like a fever dream.

Tung Tung
A living, walking wooden drum (inspired by Indonesian bedug) with a baseball bat. While sometimes mistaken as Italian Brainrot, he’s a crossover character who adds international flair to the madness.

Ballerina Cappuccina
A graceful dancer with a cappuccino cup for a head. She pirouettes through scenes of total nonsense, highlighting the game’s charming chaos
Instructions:
Desktop Controls:
Mouse Click: Click on the difference.

📱 Mobile Controls:
Tap: Tap on the difference.

🤪 Bonus Tips:
Some differences are sneaky—look for color swaps, missing items, or silly changes.

No timer—play at your own pace.

Each level gets more bizarre, so keep those eyes sharp!

- A variety of different weapons, from bats and knives to grenade launchers, flamethrowers and plasma guns! Collect your fighters and win!

Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: Idle merge game where you need to create a squad from different components and progress through levels to defeat enemies.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no specific storyline, but the objective is clear: gather a squad and defeat enemies.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?
A: An interesting mechanic of collecting and upgrading the squad in parts.

Q: Are there bosses, and how are they different?
A: Yes, bosses are very tough, requiring a strong squad to defeat. Players also have heroes at their disposal.

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on chests from which parts for squad members are obtained.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: Open chests, get squad member parts, combine them, and level up the squad.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does donating speed up game progress?
A: Yes, they allow speeding up squad gathering and significantly strengthening it.

Q: Are there engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: There are references to action franchises (the very first hero is Shredder from Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles).

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, the entire game is built around squad customization.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to return?
A: No.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to better immerse in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in playing without sound?
A: Yes, but it's not mandatory.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, match-three puzzles within a strategy game.
A: Mini-game based on merging and squad collection.

Q: Is the number of levels clear? How many are there? (skip if unclear)
A: Yes, it is indicated in the UI.

Q: Are there achievement systems? What are they, and what can you get them for?
A: No.

To increase the level of items - combine 2 identical items.

To buy a loot box - click the button with the image of the loot box and the price tag. 
To open the loot box - click on the loot box in the inventory. 
To create a fighter, drag the item to the equipment cell and click the "Create" button 
To send the squad into battle - click the "TO BATTLE" button

Addictive Merge Gameplay

Quest System

WHY PLAYERS LOVE MERGE PUZZLE:

- Easy to learn, challenging to master
- No time pressure - play at your own pace

- Relaxing yet engaging gameplay
- Works offline - play anywhere, anytime
- Regular updates with new content

Perfect for puzzle lovers, number game enthusiasts, and anyone who enjoys brain training games. Whether you have a few minutes or a few hours, Merge Puzzle delivers satisfying gameplay every session.
Instructions:
HOW TO PLAY MERGE PUZZLE - 2048 BLOCKS

BASIC GAMEPLAY:

1. TAP TO SELECT
Tap any numbered tile on the board. All connected tiles with the same number will be highlighted. Tiles connect horizontally, vertically, and diagonally.

2. MERGE TILES
Tap again to merge all highlighted tiles into one. The merged tile appears at your tap location with a higher value. The more tiles you connect, the higher the resulting number!

3. SCORE POINTS
Each merge earns points based on the tiles merged. Create bigger combinations for massive scores. Chain reactions happen automatically when new merge opportunities appear after tiles fall.

4. REACH THE GOAL
In level mode, reach the target tile value (shown at the top) before running out of moves. In endless mode, keep merging and try to achieve the highest score possible.


MERGE FORMULA:

The game uses a special merge formula that rewards connecting more tiles:
- 2 tiles: Value doubles (2+2 = 4)
- 3-4 tiles: Value quadruples (2+2+2 = 8)
- 5-6 tiles: Value multiplies by 8 (2+2+2+2+2 = 16)
- 7+ tiles: Even bigger multipliers!

Tip: Always look for the largest groups of matching tiles for maximum points!


GAME MODES:

Level Mode
- Complete 40 levels across 4 collections
- Each level has a target tile and limited moves
- Progress unlocks new challenges

Endless Mode
- No move limit - play until the board fills up
- Try to reach the highest tile possible
- Compete on global leaderboards

Daily Challenge
- New puzzle every day for all players
- Same puzzle worldwide - compare your skills
- Special daily leaderboard


POWER-UPS:

UNDO (50 coins)
Made a mistake? Undo your last move and try a different strategy.

HAMMER (50 coins)
Remove any single tile from the board. Great for clearing blockers or setting up big merges.

SHUFFLE (50 coins)
Rearrange all tiles randomly. Use when no good moves are available.


TIPS FOR HIGH SCORES:

1. Plan Ahead
Look at the entire board before making a move. Find the largest possible group of matching tiles.

2. Work from the Bottom
Focus on merging tiles at the bottom of the board. This creates space for new tiles to fall and potentially form chains.

3. Create Chain Reactions
Position tiles so that after one merge, falling tiles create new matching groups automatically.

4. Save Power-Ups
Don't use power-ups too early. Save them for difficult situations in later levels.

5. Connect Diagonals
Remember tiles connect diagonally too! Look for diagonal chains that other players might miss.

6. Build Big Numbers
Higher value tiles are harder to match but worth more points. Try to build toward the corners where they won't block other merges.

Title: Popping Candies
Description: Popping Candies is an exhilarating puzzle game where you can match and crush candies to achieve various objectives. Play online for free without downloading and immerse yourself in the vibrant and colorful world of candy matching. This game offers a delightful escape into a realm filled with exciting challenges, engaging gameplay, and a visually pleasing environment. As you swap adjacent candies to form rows of three or more, you'll clear them from the board and create space for more strategic moves. With the potential to create special candies like striped, wrapped, or color bombs, Popping Candies keeps you on your toes with its dynamic puzzle mechanics. Overcome obstacles such as chocolate and blockers while completing each level’s unique tasks. The catch? Your moves are limited, so plan carefully. Use boosters for extra help and advance through challenging levels to unlock new stages. Whether you're on iOS, Android, or desktop, Popping Candies offers a seamless gaming experience across all platforms, making it a perfect match for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers alike.
Instructions:
Objective: The main goal is to match and crush candies to complete specific objectives within a limited number of moves.

Matching Candies: Players can swap adjacent candies to create a row or column of three or more matching candies. This will make them disappear and score points.

Objectives: Each level has its own objectives, such as reaching a certain score, collecting specific candies, or clearing jelly. Players must complete these tasks to progress.

Special Candies:

Striped Candies: Made by matching four candies in a row; they clear an entire row or column when matched.
Wrapped Candies: Made by matching five candies in a T or L shape; they explode and clear surrounding candies.
Color Bombs: Created by matching five candies of the same color; they clear all candies of that color when combined with any candy.
Obstacles: Some levels include obstacles like chocolate, jelly, and blockers that players must clear to achieve their objectives.

Moves and Lives: Players have a limited number of moves to complete a level. If they run out of moves, they lose a life. Players start with five lives and can earn more over time or purchase them.

Boosters: Players can use boosters to gain advantages, such as extra moves, special candy combinations, or clearing obstacles.

Progression: Successfully completing levels allows players to advance through the map, unlocking new levels and challenges.

Title: Geometry Vibes 3D

Geometry Vibes 3D takes everything you loved about the original Geometry Vibes and brings it into a vibrant, dynamic 3D world. With fully reimagined levels and stunning new visuals, this version elevates your reflexes and rhythm-based skills to new dimensions.

Geometry Vibes 3D reimagines the original with fully 3D levels, new features like collectible stars, difficulty modes (Rookie, Pro, Expert), a global Leaderboard, and a Market for skins and trails. The multiplayer is streamlined to 2-Player Mode for a cleaner experience.

Can I play Geometry Vibes 3D on my phone?
Absolutely! The game is optimized for mobile devices with smooth touch controls, ensuring a seamless experience on both iOS and Android.

How do I unlock the special arrow skin?
Collect stars in Classic Mode to unlock the exclusive arrow skin in the Market. You can earn up to 90 stars by completing all levels in Rookie, Pro, and Expert difficulties.

Is there an online multiplayer mode?
Geometry Vibes 3D features local 2-Player Mode for face-to-face competition. While there’s no online multiplayer, you can compete globally via the Endless Mode Leaderboard.

 Why is there only 2-Player Mode instead of 4-Player Mode like the original?
To maintain clear visuals and avoid clutter in the 3D environment, we focused on a polished 2-Player local multiplayer experience.

Title: Fortress Clash
Description:
Fixed the reported issue: progress was not restored after a reload.

Root cause: bridge.storage.get() returns the saved value already parsed as an object, while the game expected a JSON string and parsed it again, which threw and silently discarded the save.

Changes:
- storage.get() now accepts both shapes (object and string).
- The save is loaded BEFORE gameplay is shown: a loading screen is displayed and input is ignored until storage.get() resolves, so a fresh default save can no longer overwrite real progress during startup.
- Saves carry a revision counter, so after "finish a level, then buy an upgrade" the newest copy always wins instead of an older one at the same level.
- Any pending write is flushed on page hide / unload, so the last action before a reload is never lost.

Verified in the QA tool: state written before Reload game is fully restored after it.
Instructions: Pick a block or unit from the bottom tray, then tap the grid to place it on your cart and build your fort and army. Blocks cost coins; every win pays out coins and lets you choose a bonus reward. Press Battle to launch - your archers and units fire at the enemy fort automatically. Win by destroying the enemy king: knock him off his cart, bury him in rubble, or blast through his walls. Spend coins on the Upgrade screen to level up units and unlock new weapons (cannon, crossbow, laser, grenade). Play with mouse or touch - no keyboard needed.

Description:

As you clear levels you climb an evolution ladder: atom, molecule, cell, fish, dinosaur, human… all the way to mind.

How to play: a grid of letters and a list of words. Drag your finger to spell each word. In this word find the letters can bend around corners, not just run in straight lines, so it's a fresh twist on the classic word search.

Features:
• Hundreds of hand-crafted levels, from easy to hard
• Fully offline — no wifi, no internet needed
• Big, clear letters and a calm pace — great for adults and kids

Enjoy the game!
Instructions:
1. You're given a grid of letter tiles. Every letter is part of a hidden word — your goal is to find all the words and fill the whole board.

2. Press and drag your finger (or the mouse) across connected letters to trace a word. Unlike a straight-line word search, in Fillwords the path can bend around corners.

3. Release to submit. If the word is correct, its tiles lock in with color. If not, just try a different path — nothing is lost.

4. Find every word to clear the level. There's no timer and no pressure — take your time.

5. As you complete levels, you climb an evolution ladder — from atom and molecule all the way to mind.

6. Stuck on a word? Use a Hint to reveal a letter.

7. Tap any solved word to see what it means and grow your vocabulary.

Tip: the game works fully offline, so you can play anywhere.

Title: Flippee Ball
Description:
A HYBRID ARCADE GAME OF PINBALL & BASKETBALL

-Play against the CPU or another player on the same device.  
-Perfect your technique in the Academy - 100 increasingly challenging "assists" for you to try to score from.
Instructions:
You control one set of flippers - either red or blue.  Flipping uses just one button and flips all five of your flippers.  See if you have what it takes to beat the computer.  The default settings are "AMATEUR" speed against the computer on "EASY" difficulty with "AIM ASSIST" enabled (this gives you a little help with shot accuracy).  Once you feel comfortable, try the other difficulties, "PROFFESSIONAL" speed, then switch "AIM ASSIST" off!

If that's not enough, try the "FLIPPEE ACADEMY" - 100 levels (50 each at "AMATEUR" & "PROFESSIONAL" speeds) where the ball is launched and you must try to score - but each level only allows for a certain number of touches - and you must score before the ball hits your opponent's flippers.

Navigate menus using:
- Mouse
- Touch
- Keyboard (arrow keys and space to action)
- Controller - direction pad and any of the main four buttons

Use the game mode button to the left of the scoreboard to select between 7 game modes:

- Longest Streak - see how many games in a row you can win against the computer:
  - Easy
  - Medium
  - Hard
  - Progressive (difficulty increases with every game)
- Career - difficulty increases with every game, but losing doesn't reset progress
- Player v Player - play against another human on the same device
- Academy - 100 "assists" for you to try to score from 

To flip:

Single player:
- Mouse - click the screen
- Touch - tap the screen
- Keyboard - LEFT CTRL
- Controller - any of the four main buttons

Player vs Player:
- Mouse - click the top left or top right of the screen to control either the left or right flippers
- Touch - tap the top left or top right of the screen
- Keyboard - LEFT CTRL (left flipper) & RIGHT ARROW (right flippers)
- Controller - any of the four main buttons (supports 2 controllers for player v player)

To pause:

- Mouse - click the scoreboard
- Touch - tap the scoreboard
- Keyboard - Press "P"
- Controller - "Start" button

To win:

SCORE MORE THAN YOUR OPPONENT!

Change the game speed from "AMATEUR" to "PROFESSIONAL" and disable "AIM ASSIST" (if you're up for a challeng!) in the SETTINGS menu.
A quick start guide is shown when the game is first run and full instructions can be found in the built-in help guide.

The main game mode offers a huge number of handcrafted levels designed to challenge both casual players and puzzle fans.

A standout feature is the sandbox mode. Here you can freely choose shapes, experiment with mechanics, or even draw and design your own levels from scratch. Test your ideas, create unique puzzles, and enjoy endless replayability.
Instructions: At the start of each level, snakes are tangled into a single shape. Your goal is to untangle it completely. Tap snakes one by one — only snakes that are not blocked can move. Choosing the wrong order will stop your progress, so think ahead. In sandbox mode, you can select preset shapes or draw your own levels and try to solve them.

Title: Bubble Tower
Description:
Bubble Tower 3D is a relaxing 3D bubble-pop / color-match puzzle game.
You rotate a tower (or cylinder) loaded with colored bubbles around its vertical axis.
Your goal is to shoot bubbles, matching colors to connect groups of the same color. When matched, those bubbles pop/drop off the tower.
There are many levels; difficulty increases as you go. More bubble colors, trickier arrangements, limited shots, etc.
Also there are diamonds or special gems you can collect in certain levels. These may unlock “shiny shapes” or cosmetic things.
The graphics are clean, simple, and meant for relaxing casual play. It mixes mental challenge (where to shoot, color matching) with a soothing visual.
Instructions:
A tower appears with a cluster of bubbles of various colors. There’s a shooter that holds the next bubble to fire.
You can rotate the tower around (usually by dragging left/right or using onscreen controls) to bring bubbles of matching color in position.
Tap or drag to aim, then let go (or tap a location) to shoot the bubble toward the tower. Match it with other bubbles of the same color.
When you connect 3 or more bubbles of the same color, those bubbles pop/drop off. Bubbles that are hanging (i.e. no longer connected to the base or other bubbles) also fall off.
Some levels include diamonds or special gems placed in certain parts of the bubble structure. You need to target those, maybe by matching bubbles around them or popping surrounding bubbles to let them fall.
You win a level if all bubbles (or the required ones) are cleared. If you run out of shots (or fail to clear the required bubbles), you lose and must retry.

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about and what do you do?

A: It's an arcade game focused on obby and speed. You need to run to increase your speed and raise your level.

Q: What is the game's hook? What will keep players engaged?

A: A unique obstacle course, a rebirth system, leaderboards, and high-quality block graphics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the leveling system work? What's the best way to progress quickly?

A: The more you run, the higher your speed becomes, allowing you to travel further and earn more trophies.

Q: Is the total number of levels known? How many are there?

A: There are 5 different levels.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?

A: The game features two currencies: trophies and steps. Trophies are earned by reaching the end of one of the five levels, while steps can be purchased in the shop or earned through training.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and how do they affect the game? Does paying speed up progress?

A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. You can buy boosters, skins (colored trails for your character), treadmills to increase running speed, and instant experience (steps).

Q: Is customization available? Can you adjust the hero's appearance, use a level editor, tune vehicles, etc.?

A: Yes, you can purchase a colored trail that follows your character while running.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them and what types are there?

A: There are two leaderboards: one for the number of trophies collected and another for time spent in prison.

Q: Is it better to play with sound for immersion, or will it be difficult to progress without it?

A: The music complements the game well, but it is not required to complete the levels.

Title: CatDoku
Description: CatDoku is a cozy logic puzzle with cute cats! Place the fluffy heroes on the board following three simple rules: one cat per row and column, one cat per color, and no cats in adjacent cells. Easy rules — but the further you go, the trickier the levels get.
Instructions:
The goal is to place cats on the board so that all three rules are satisfied.

CatDoku Rules:
🐾 1 cat per row and column — exactly one cat in each row and each column.
🐾 1 cat per color — exactly one cat in each colored zone.
🐾 Cats are not adjacent — no two cats can be in neighboring cells, including diagonally.

How to play:

Tap an empty cell to place a cat.
Tap it again to remove it.
Arrange all the cats so that no rule is broken.

Tips:
• Look for rows, columns, and colored zones with the fewest empty cells left — start with those.
• Once you place a cat, mentally cross out its neighboring cells, as well as its entire row, column, and color.
• If you're unsure — use the hint, it will reveal a correct position.

Clear all 100+ levels and become a CatDoku master!

Title: Obby Toilet Line
Description:
Obby Toilet Line starts in the most chaotic place imaginable: a gas station restroom line. Around 30 different characters are already waiting, and the queue stretches all the way past the store entrance. Your goal is simple, but the situation is not: earn money while you wait, move up the line, and reach the mysterious toilet at the end. This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn.

This is not just a “stand still” queue. The game uses an idle-style progression system: the position you’re standing in determines how much you earn. To advance to the next spot, you must collect the required amount first. And there’s pressure, because sometimes the character behind you can act fast and push you back one place, making it even more important to keep earning and climbing.


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an idle game where you have to wait in line for the toilet and then enter the magical VIP world of idle games.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no storyline, but the task is crystal clear. Wait in line, enter the VIP zone, and collect as many bonuses as possible for leveling up.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? How can it engage players?
A: The game has an unusual setting with a large number of mini-games.

Q: Are there any currencies in the game and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Currencies can be spent on character customization and leveling up to progress through the toilet queue faster.

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: By entering the VIP zone, you can speed up the queue progression.

Q: What are some engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: There are numerous customization options and many references to popular culture.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can change everything about the character.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse oneself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties in passing without sound?
A: The game has pleasant sound, but it is not necessary for progression.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main storyline? For example, "match three" puzzles within a strategy game.
A: There are many additional games within the VIP zone.

Shift: Sprint

Player 2

Survive as long as you can and dig as deep as possible into the endless dungeons!

Title: Slope 3D
Description:
Slope 3D sends you down a steep neon track where quick reactions and precise movement decide how long your run will last. Guide the rolling ball through narrow platforms, sharp turns, sudden drops, and dangerous red obstacles while the speed continues to increase. The controls are simple to learn, but staying on the course becomes harder with every passing second.

Game Overview
Your objective in Slope 3D is to keep the ball on the track for as long as possible and achieve the highest score. The ball rolls forward automatically, leaving you responsible for steering it away from barriers, gaps, and the edges of the platform.

The slope changes constantly as you progress. Wide paths can quickly become narrow lanes, while sudden turns and uneven platforms force you to adjust your position without losing control. Red blocks are especially dangerous because touching one ends the current run immediately.

Speed is one of the biggest challenges. The farther you travel, the faster the ball moves, giving you less time to react to what appears ahead. A small steering mistake that seems harmless early in the run can send the ball off the track once the pace increases.

Key Features
- Fast-paced 3D endless runner gameplay
- Futuristic neon environment
- Simple left-and-right steering controls
- Increasing speed and difficulty
- Narrow tracks, sharp turns, and sudden gaps
- Dangerous red obstacles to avoid
- Score-based progression with no fixed finish line
- Keyboard controls for desktop players 
- Swipe and tilt controls for mobile devices
- Quick rounds designed for repeated high-score attempts

Tips for Beginners
- Use short taps instead of holding a direction for too long.
- Try to keep the ball near the center of the track.
- Look ahead rather than focusing only on the ball.
- Begin steering before reaching sharp turns.
- Avoid unnecessary movement on narrow platforms.

Advanced Tips
- Plan your position based on the next section of the course.
- Use gentle corrections when the ball reaches higher speeds.
- Enter narrow paths from the center whenever possible.
- Move early when several obstacles appear close together.
- Stay calm after sudden drops and regain control gradually.

Common Mistakes
- Making large steering movements at high speed.
- Waiting until the last moment to avoid an obstacle.
- Staying too close to the edge of the platform.
- Watching the current position instead of the upcoming track.
- Trying to correct one mistake with another sudden turn.

Slope 3D game turns a simple steering mechanic into a demanding test of focus, balance, and reflexes. Its endless course means every run offers another opportunity to travel farther and improve your score. Stay centered, react smoothly, and see how long you can survive as the neon slope becomes faster and more difficult.

Move Right: Right Arrow or D

Mobile Controls

Enjoy simple controls, stunning 3D graphics, and a choice of 1-player or 2-player modes across hundreds of challenging levels.

How to Play Sky Balls 3D
Let's say that Sky Balls 3D seems easier than it looks, and in the first few rounds, it's actually possible to coast through to the end without finding that perfect balance to avoid getting cast off the edge of the path. But once the obstacles start appearing, you will be forced to play tactically, so don't get too used to coasting.

There are multiple obstacles to look out for, like no guardrails, narrowing roads, curves, and excessive incline speed, not to mention road barriers, which you need to avoid or slightly navigate around.

Collect coins
Collect coins along the way for game upgrades, which include new sceneries, landscapes, and views.

Two players are better than one.
If you thought playing the game on your own was exhilarating, have a go at the 2-player gameplay with a friend. The game gets even more exciting as you try to focus on the speed and stability of your rolling ball while desperately trying not to look at how your opponent is doing. The game is fast-paced, and one moment where you lack focus may just throw you off, literally, off the board.

Use WASD / arrow keys to control the ball

2-player mode:
Player 1: Use WASD to control the ball

Title: Square Crusher
Description:
Get ready for a fun and satisfying cube-crushing puzzle experience in SQUARE CRUSHER!
In this game, you need to tap on unlocked fill cubes or boxes only. When you tap a cube or box, it falls into the crusher. The crusher breaks it and generates colorful balls. These balls fall onto the board and move toward the conveyor belt if there is space. Your main goal is to match the crushed balls with the correct front crates. When the balls pass near the crates, matching balls will automatically go inside the correct crate. Once a crate is full, the next crate in the queue moves forward. But be careful! Do not blindly tap on unlocked cubes or boxes. If you tap without planning, the generated balls may not match with the front crates. This can fill the conveyor belt quickly and create no space for new balls. Fill all crates, clear all boxes, and complete the level before the conveyor belt gets full!
Instructions:
-Tap on full cube or box.
-The tapped cube or box will fall down into the crusher.
-The crusher will crush it and generate balls.
-The balls will fall onto the board.
-If there is space, the balls will move onto the conveyor belt.
-When balls pass near the front crates, matching balls will automatically go inside the correct crate.

Use angles to bounce around corners smartly.

Fire Power:
This bonus gives your ball a flaming speed boost.
It’s useful for long straight shots or when you want to quickly cross a large gap.
Best used when you need maximum distance in a single strike.

Wing / Glide Power:
This bonus allows your ball to glide smoothly as if it has wings.
It reduces friction and gives your ball a longer travel path with better control.
Ideal for precision shots where you want distance but also don’t want to overshoot too wildly.

Spring / Bounce Power:
This bonus acts like a spring-loaded push.
It helps your ball bounce forward with extra force, perfect for overcoming obstacles or making tricky jumps.
Best for courses with barriers, ramps, or platforms where normal shots can’t reach.

Title: 3D Dots
Description:
3D Dots is a relaxing connect-the-dots puzzle that happens in real 3D space. Every level starts as a cloud of numbered dots floating in the air — link them with the right lines and a hidden object comes to life.

The number on each dot tells you how many lines it needs, so there is no guessing, only clean logic. Unlike flat dot-to-dot games, the puzzle has depth: orbit the camera to look at the figure from any side and find connections you could not see before.
Instructions:
Tap a dot and drag a line to another dot to connect them.

The number inside a dot shows how many lines must meet there — when it is satisfied, the dot turns green. A wrong link turns red: tap the red line to remove it and try another pair.

Swipe on empty space to rotate the camera — the puzzle is three-dimensional, and some dots are hidden behind others until you turn the model.

Pinch or scroll to zoom.

Connect every dot correctly and the model is revealed and added to your gallery; larger models are assembled part by part. 

Stuck? Use the Hint button to reveal one correct connection. Complete as many models as you can to climb the leaderboard.

Title: 3D Chess - Arcane Edition
Description:
Step into a mystical enchanted garden and play chess like never before.

3D Chess - Arcane Edition brings the classic strategy game to life with stunning 3D visuals, hand-crafted copper and gold pieces, and an immersive fairytale atmosphere. Challenge spirits across three difficulty levels — from casual fun to a serious test of skill.
Whether you're a beginner learning the game or a seasoned player looking for a quick match, this beautifully crafted chess experience is designed to captivate and challenge.

Instructions:
Tap a piece to select it, then tap a highlighted square to move. The glowing dots show your legal moves. Capture enemy pieces by moving onto their square. Put the opponent's king in checkmate to win.

Controls:

Tap/click a piece to select it.
Tap/click a highlighted square to move.
Drag to rotate the camera around the board.
Pinch or scroll to zoom in/out.
Use the Hint button (lightbulb) to reveal the best move (3 per game, watch a short ad).
Access Settings (gear icon) to change difficulty, toggle move hints, or mute audio.

FAQ's:

1: How do I play against a friend in 3D Chess - Arcane Edition? 
Tap "Play a Friend" on the landing screen to create a private room, then share the room code. The other person can open the link and play as the other colour.

2: Do I need an account to play? 
No. There's no login and no database — just pick a name, play, and close the tab when you're done. Multiplayer rooms are temporary: once everyone leaves, the game and its history are gone for good.

3: How strong is the computer opponent? 
3D Chess - Arcane Chess runs Stockfish, one of the strongest chess engines in the world, directly in your browser. You can set it to Easy, Medium, or Hard from the settings before or during a solo game.

4: Can I get a hint if I'm stuck? 
Yes — the lightbulb button offers up to 3 hints per game (with a short cooldown between uses), highlighting the engine's recommended move. In solo mode this is a rewarded feature.

5: Does 3D Chess - Arcane Edition work on mobile? 
Yes. Pieces can be tapped or dragged with touch, the camera automatically adapts the board framing to phone screens, and the game rotates itself into a landscape layout on upright phones so the board isn't cramped in portrait.

Title: 4 Clues 1 Word
Description:
Think you’re a master of language? Put your lateral thinking to the test with 4 Clues 1 Word, the word puzzle game that goes beyond the surface. Most games ask you to find a simple object; we ask you to find the hidden connection between worlds.

Whether it’s the Stock in a financial market, a pot of Stock on a stove, or the Stock in a warehouse—your job is to find the one word that rules them all. Featuring stunning, high-definition photography and curated levels ranging from "Casual" to "Mind-Bending," 4 Clues 1 Word is designed for the curious, the clever, and the linguistically brave.

It’s not just a game; it’s a workout for your synapses. Can you see the pattern?
Instructions:
Observe the Imagery: Each level presents you with three or four distinct images. Look closely—one might be a physical object, another an abstract concept, and the third an action.

Find the Common Thread: Identify the single word that applies to all images. Remember: we love polysemy (words with multiple meanings). A "Draft" could be a cold breeze or a rough sketch of a masterpiece.

Type Your Answer: Use the provided letter tiles to spell out the word.sss

Use Your Intuition (and Hints): Stuck on a particularly "Hard" level?

Expose a Letter: Reveal a single correct letter in the word.

Remove Tiles: Get rid of letters that aren't part of the solution.

Climb the Ranks: Progress through hundreds of levels. The further you go, the more abstract the connections become.

Pro Tip: If you're stuck, try saying the names of the objects out loud. Sometimes the ear catches what the eye misses!

Punch the dummies, enjoy the chaos, and move on to the next scene!

Click on the screen to punch the annoying dummies.

Title: Basket Sport Stars
Description:
Basket Sport Stars brings fast, playful basketball matches to colorful courts filled with unpredictable moments. Choose a character, challenge a computer-controlled rival, or share the keyboard with a friend in local 2-player mode. Move into position, time your jump, aim carefully, and score as many baskets as possible before the final buzzer.

Every match is short enough to start quickly but competitive enough to demand focus. A well-timed shot can put you ahead, while a successful attack may force your opponent to lose possession. With different characters, changing arenas, several game modes, and useful power-ups, no two matches feel exactly the same.

Choose Your Game Mode
Quick Match sends you straight into a 90-second basketball battle. The player with the most points when time runs out wins. It is the best mode for learning the basics or enjoying a fast match without a longer commitment.

Tournament Mode places you into a competitive bracket against several opponents. Win each round, adapt to different characters and courts, and continue advancing until you reach the final match.

Practice Mode gives you room to learn movement, shooting, and attack timing. Use it to test jump shots, understand the aiming guide, and become more comfortable with the controls before entering harder matches.

2 Player Mode lets two players compete locally on the same keyboard. Challenge a friend, fight for possession, and find out who can score more baskets before the buzzer.

Master the Shooting System
Jump to reach the ball, then hold the shooting control to aim toward the opposing basket. A dotted trajectory line shows where the ball is expected to travel. Watch the line closely and release at the right moment for a more accurate attempt.

The aiming indicator briefly turns green when the shot has a strong chance of reaching the hoop. This window does not stay open for long, so successful shooting depends on quick reactions and controlled timing rather than pressing the button as fast as possible.

Attack and Take Possession
Basketball is not only about shooting. When your opponent controls the ball, move close and use the attack button to weaken their grip. After enough successful hits, the rival drops the ball and gives you a chance to take possession.

Attacking without a plan can leave your basket unprotected. Try to pressure the opponent when they are preparing a shot or moving into a dangerous position, then return quickly before they recover.

Collect and Use Gift Boxes
A flying gift box may appear during a match. Jump to collect it and save the reward for the right opportunity. Activating the gift launches a rocket across the court that can stun the opposing player and interrupt their attack.

The rocket can also become a threat when your rival uses one. Watch its direction and jump over it to avoid being stunned. A well-timed gift can change the score, especially during the final seconds of a close match.

Key Features
- Fast arcade-style basketball matches
- Single-player and local 2-player gameplay
- Quick Match, Tournament, Practice, and 2 Player modes
- Competitive 90-second rounds
- Different characters and colorful basketball courts
- Timing-based aiming and shooting system
- Attacks that can force opponents to drop the ball
- Gift boxes with special rocket power-ups
- Simple keyboard controls for both players
- Short matches designed for repeated play

Tips for Beginners
- Start in Practice Mode to learn how long to hold the shooting button.
- Release the ball when the aiming guide gives you a clear trajectory.
- Stay between your opponent and the basket when defending.
- Do not attack constantly; wait until you are close enough to connect.
- Collect gift boxes whenever the court is safe.
- Keep watching the timer during close matches.

Advanced Tips
- Use short jumps to control possession instead of always attempting a shot.
- Attack just before the opponent releases the ball to disrupt their timing.
- Save a rocket gift for a dangerous attack or the final seconds of the match.
- Change your shooting position so the opponent cannot predict every attempt.
- After stealing the ball, create space before aiming at the basket.
- In tournaments, adjust your strategy to each opponent instead of repeating the same moves.

Common Mistakes
- Releasing every shot before the aiming line is properly aligned.
- Standing too close to the opponent while trying to aim.
- Ignoring defense after taking an early lead.
- Using gift rewards immediately without checking the rival's position.
- Chasing the ball and leaving the basket completely open.
- Forgetting that the match can be decided in the final few seconds.

Become the Court Star
Basket Sport Stars combines accessible controls with quick competitive matches, accurate shooting, defensive attacks, and unexpected power-ups. Practice your timing, choose the right moment to challenge your opponent, and work your way through the tournament. Whether you compete against the CPU or face a friend on the same keyboard, every match offers another chance to become the star of the court.

Player 1
Move: A and D
Jump: W
Aim and Shoot: Hold W and release
Attack: S
Use Gift: G

Player 2
Move: Left and Right Arrow Keys
Jump: Up Arrow
Aim and Shoot: Hold Up Arrow and release
Attack: Down Arrow
Use Gift: L

Drag to spin the snack and check every side — sneaky bands love to hide around the back.
Stuck? Use a powerup:
⚡ Zap — cut any band, even a buried one
🧲 Magnet — yanks the top band off for you
🔍 Finder — highlights the band that's safe to pop
🛡️ Shield — forgives your next mistake
Clear the level to earn coins and stars, push your Gold Quest forward, and race the bees to the finish!

Hitting the anvil → improving strength
🔹 Walls to splinters → Cups to pocket
🔹 Cups → pets → even more power
Are you ready to become the ultimate dungeon destroyer? Come in and start smashing! 🔥


Core Gameplay & Story

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an idle game where you need to hit the anvils, increase your strength, and break walls.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: There is no storyline, but the goal is to level up, become stronger, earn the best pets, many trophies, and power.

Q: What is the unique feature of the game? What can hook players in?
A: The pleasant visual style of the game, daily rewards, a wheel of fortune, pets, and a lot of progression.

Q: Are there bosses and how are they different?
A: Instead of bosses, there are walls that become more challenging with each broken wall.

Q: What currencies are there and what can they be spent on (regular - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: The key currency is trophies, which can be used to spin a pet box, buy character skins, and unlock new areas. Strength can be used to unlock weapon skins.

Mechanics & Progression

Q: How does leveling up work exactly? What needs to be done to level up faster?
A: You need to hit the anvil and increase your strength. The higher the character's strength, the higher the attack power, and the faster the walls break.

Economy & Customization

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what does it affect? Does making purchases speed up game progress?
A: Yes, there are VIP statuses that significantly speed up progress. There is an option to disable ads. There is a doubling of strength.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize the appearance of the hero, location editor, car tuning, etc.?
A: Yes, you can fully customize everything about your character, including weapons.

Retention & Engagement

Q: Are there leaderboards? How to access them? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: Yes, there are leaderboards for broken walls and regenerations of all time. You can access them by breaking walls and progressing in the game to activate regeneration.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, cars, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: There are many skins and pleasant graphics.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages players to come back?
A: Yes, there are rewards for time spent in the game.

Q: Is it preferable to play with sound to immerse yourself better in the atmosphere, or will there be difficulties with gameplay without sound?
A: The music is pleasant and complements the gameplay.

Snowy Adventures with Noob and Pro! — a fun snowy adventure where you play solo or with a friend, leveling up your tree to make it the coolest in the world! Collect rare toys, play mini-games, and show everyone your tree is the top 🎄❄️

Collect toys, craft the best decorations, and turn your tree into a legendary snowy world icon ❄️👑
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about, and what do you do?
A: It is a 2D game where you grow and decorate your own Christmas tree by playing various mini-games. You earn ""gifts"" as currency, and the larger your tree grows, the more rewards you receive.

Q: Is there a storyline in the game?
A: Not exactly, but the premise is that you need to save Christmas and help Santa.

Q: What is the game's unique hook? What will draw players in?
A: It features Minecraft references, a wide variety of mini-games and rewards, high-quality graphics, and a local co-op mode to play with a friend on one screen. There is also a wheel of fortune, character skins, and a crafting system for Christmas ornaments.

Q: What are the most engaging content elements?
A: Minecraft-inspired references and themes.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? How can players level up faster?
A: Play mini-games to earn ""Bucks,"" then use them to upgrade and grow your Christmas tree.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main gameplay?
A: Yes, there are many mini-games, including catching falling Bucks while dodging bombs, delivering gifts and coal to houses, throwing snowballs at targets, and defending sweets from zombies.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: There is an in-game currency called ""Bucks"" used to water the tree, upgrade ornaments for earning boosts, and level up mini-games. There is also a ""Gifts"" currency used to purchase more Christmas tree decorations.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and does it affect progression?
A: Yes, you can purchase various ""Bucks"" packs as well as character skins.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you join them and what types are available?
A: Yes, your rank is determined by how much and how quickly you earn from your Christmas tree.

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar retention mechanics?
A: Yes, there is a reward system that grants prizes for every 5 minutes of playtime.

Q: Is it better to play with sound on, or can the game be completed without it?
A: It is not required, but playing with sound adds significantly to the festive atmosphere.
Instructions:
Play together on one device — each controls their own character while leveling up the tree and causing snowy chaos! ❄️🎄

🎮 Player 1 Controls:
• A / S / D — move
• W — jump
• Q — action
The rest you’ll figure out on the fly 😉

🎮 Player 2 Controls:
• ← / ↓ / → — move
• ↑ — jump
• Enter — action
Everything else is pretty intuitive 😎

Work as a team, throw snowballs, play mini-games, and make your tree the coolest ever! ☃️🔥

Title: Fruitsland: Escape from the Amusement Park
Description:
Welcome to Fruitsland – a unique amusement park where fun awaits at every turn! Colorful carousels, exciting rides, and entertainers dressed as fruits – apples, bananas, watermelons, and oranges – fill the park. Children’s laughter fills the air, as school groups with teachers and families with kids flock to enjoy the day. Everything seems perfect, but not all is as it seems... One careless step, and you fall through an old hatch, landing in a spooky, long-abandoned part of the park hidden underground.

Before you lies a chilling, forgotten underground park where strange scientific experiments were once conducted. Only remnants of these experiments remain now, with crumbling rides and deserted game rooms that carry no joy. An eerie silence surrounds you, broken only by the sounds of old machinery and the shuffling of mysterious creatures. The first location is themed around apples – at first, it seems harmless, but soon you realize you’re trapped. As you study the remnants of the scientists’ journals, you uncover their plans to bring fruit to life, fruit that would entertain visitors around the clock. The sinister plan of the park’s owner aimed to turn fruits into real entertainers, capable of anything to amuse guests.

Your mission now is to escape from this underground horror. Every step brings new puzzles, challenging tasks, and deadly monsters that lurk around every corner, the results of failed experiments. Surviving here won’t be easy: these animated fruits have come to life, and now they’re hunting you. Every corner is a new survival test filled with horror, fear, and adrenaline. Choose your path wisely, solve puzzles to find your way out, and avoid deadly traps and monsters that only look like harmless fruits.

Title: Laser Survivor

Laser Survivor, a cyberpunk roguelike action-adventure set in a neon-drenched post-apocalypse, the last hope for humanity rests in the hands of five heroes fighting hordes of demons pouring through a dimensional rift. Featuring pixel art visuals, randomized weapons, chiptune soundtracks, and relentless survival gameplay, every run is a test of adaptation and skill.

Story
The world has fallen. A dimensional rift has unleashed an unstoppable flood of demons, tearing through what remains of civilization. But from the chaos, five warriors rise. Each wielding unique powers forged for survival in this cyberpunk hellscape. Dropped at random into corrupted maps, they must adapt with whatever weapons and passive abilities they find, carving their path through waves of enemies, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering the truth behind the rift. The fate of Earth depends on them.

Heroes
Blaze: Fires homing bullets that lock onto the nearest enemy, ensuring no demon can escape.
Neon: Projects a protective energy shield that damages anything foolish enough to get close.
Hunter: Drops explosives that create deadly zones, controlling the battlefield with traps.
Slash: Slices enemies apart with razor-sharp horizontal cuts that pierce entire hordes.
Jaxx: A cyber-brute with massive, scaling area damage, crushing everything in his path.


Features
Cyberpunk Roguelike Gameplay: Every run is unique, with randomized spawn points, weapons, and abilities.
5 Maps to Conquer: Battle through the Lab, Forest, Crypt, Factory, and Dungeon, each swarming with demon hordes.
10 Active Weapons & 10 Passive Abilities: Build your arsenal on the fly as you adapt to randomized loadouts.
8 Missions & 11 Upgrades: Progress through challenging missions, earn permanent upgrades, and unlock new survival tactics.
Collectibles & Lore: Discover secrets that reveal the origins of the rift and the story behind the invasion.
Retro Pixel Art: Neon-infused visuals with hand-crafted pixel art and gameplay by the Felicity team.
80s Chiptune Soundtrack: Pulsating tracker music by Drozerix, driving the action with nostalgic energy.

Why Play Laser Survivor?
Fast-paced roguelike survival set in a sci-fi cyberpunk apocalypse.
Play as five unique heroes, each with distinct base abilities and upgrade paths.
Endless replayability with randomized runs and evolving builds.
Perfect for fans of pixel art shooters, bullet-hell roguelikes, and retro-inspired chiptune soundtracks.

Laser Survivor is more than survival. It’s humanity’s last stand in a cyberpunk post-apocalypse. Will you master the chaos, close the rift, and save the world... or be consumed by the demons?

The core gameplay revolves around scanning a grid of pirate icons (flags, treasure chests, swords, anchors, etc.) to find identical pairs and connect them using at most 3 straight lines without the path being blocked by other tiles — a classic “Mahjong Solitaire-style” matching rule that demands spatial awareness and quick thinking. As you clear the board, a treasure-hunt atmosphere unfolds with colorful pirate graphics, progressive difficulty, stars-based scoring, and fun power-ups, making it easy to pick up yet endlessly challenging for players of all ages.
Instructions:
Become a Pirate Legend!

Step into the shoes of a fearless pirate captain and clear every treasure-filled board that stands in your way. In this delightful tile-matching puzzle game, you’ll scan the grid of pirate icons — flags, treasure chests, swords, anchors, pistols, compasses and more — to find identical pairs and connect them with  at most 3 straight lines without the path being blocked. Match all tiles to clear the board, earn up to 3 stars, and conquer hundreds of progressively challenging levels in a vibrant pirate adventure atmosphere!

Desktop Controls:
Mouse: Click the first tile, then click the matching tile to connect them (valid path with ≤3 lines will automatically link).  
Hint Button: Click the lightbulb icon for help.  
Pause: Click the pause button.

Mobile Controls:
Tap: Tap the first tile, then tap the identical tile to match them (the game checks for a valid path with maximum 3 lines).  
Hint Button: Tap the lightbulb icon.  
Pause: Tap the pause button.

Title: Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle
Description:
Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle combines colorful region puzzles with simple but challenging placement rules. Your goal is to place exactly one cat inside every colored territory while making sure no two cats share the same row or column.

Cats also need their personal space. They cannot touch each other diagonally, even at the corners. Every placement affects the entire board, so careful observation and logical thinking are essential.

The puzzles begin gently, allowing you to understand the rules and develop your strategy. As you progress, the boards become more challenging and require deeper planning. Every cat must be placed for a clear reason, because random guesses can quickly lead to mistakes.

Wrong moves cost hearts, so take your time and study the grid before tapping. Eliminate impossible spaces, compare colored regions, and use row and column restrictions to discover the correct solution.

Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle is perfect for players who enjoy Sudoku, logic grids, brain teasers, and relaxing puzzle games. Its simple controls and adorable cat theme make every challenge easy to start but satisfying to master.

How to Play
Place One Cat in Every Region

Each colored territory must contain exactly one cat. Leaving a region empty or placing multiple cats inside it will prevent you from completing the puzzle.

Avoid Matching Rows and Columns

No two cats can appear in the same horizontal row or vertical column. A placed cat blocks every other space along both lines.

Keep Cats Apart

Cats cannot touch diagonally. Even if two cats only meet at their corners, the placement is not allowed.

Protect Your Hearts

Incorrect taps reduce your available hearts. Think carefully, use logic, and avoid guessing whenever possible.

Features
Relaxing cat-themed logic puzzles
One cat required in every colored region
Row and column exclusion rules
Diagonal placement restrictions
Heart-based mistake system
Simple tap controls
Increasing puzzle difficulty
Clean and colorful visuals
Short levels for quick play sessions
Brain training through logical deduction
Easy to understand and challenging to master

Study every region, find the safest spaces, and place all the cats correctly in Catdoku Sudoku Puzzle.
Instructions:
Rule 1 Place one cat in each colored region Every territory needs exactly one cat. Empty regions are incomplete, and two cats in one region break the puzzle. 

Rule 2 Avoid same rows and columns A placed cat controls its entire row and column, so no other cat can share either line.

Rule 3 Do not let cats touch Cats also cannot touch diagonally. Corner contact is a conflict. 

Rule 4 Protect your hearts Wrong taps cost hearts, so every placement should come from logic instead of guessing.

The game offers a growth journey that starts with a small piece of Metal 🔩 and expands into a massive factory and investment fortune 📈📉.
Instructions:
Metal Production 🔩:
At the heart of the game lies a massive Metal (Gear) button. Each tap 👆 earns you Metal, which serves as your primary source of income.

Metals → Money 💵:
You can convert collected Metals into Money 💸 to keep your economy running. For example:
➡️ 1 Metal = 0.1 Money
➡️ 10 Metals = 1 Money

Income and Robot Program Upgrades 🤖🏭:

Purchase upgrades that increase the amount of Metal gained per tap 💪.

Factories 🏭:
At the start of the game, you begin with a single factory, which you can upgrade 🔧. You can also purchase up to three additional factories 🏭, each of which can be further developed.
Every factory has a progress bar 📊 representing its Metal production. Once the bar fills, the factory automatically sells the produced Metal, adds the profit 💵 to your balance, and the cycle restarts.

Fast Investments⚡:
📊 In the investment section, carefully observe the **candlestick movements** left by the dynamic system.
⏱️ Within about **15 seconds**, predict whether the price will go **up or down.**
💰 Then, open a **trade** in the direction you believe it will move, using your chosen amount.
🎯 If your prediction is correct, you’ll earn **double** the amount you invested! 💎🚀


Achievements 🏅:
There are 6 unique achievements 🌟 to unlock throughout the game, based on the total Metals collected 🔩, upgrades purchased 🔝, and wealth accumulated 💰.

Title: Pixel Color Flow
Description:
Pixel Color Flow is a fun, satisfying color matching puzzle game where you clear a board of pixel cubes by sending cute pigs onto a conveyor. 
Each pig drops balls onto only the cubes of the same color, so your main challenge is choosing the right order and managing the queue to clean the board efficiently.

Every pig has an ammo count (shown as a number above its head). When it runs out, the pig leaves. If ammo is still left, the pig can move into one of 5 waiting slots, ready to be sent again when you tap. The conveyor also has a capacity limit, so smart timing matters don’t overflow it.
Instructions:
Check the pixel board and spot which colors need clearing first.
Tap a pig to send it onto the conveyor.
The pig will shoot/drop balls automatically onto matching color cubes only.
Watch the ammo number above the pig—each shot uses ammo.
When ammo becomes 0, the pig leaves the run.
If it still has ammo, it can move into one of 5 waiting slots.
Tap again to send pigs from the waiting slots back onto the conveyor.
Manage the conveyor capacity (if it’s full, you must wait).
Keep repeating until you clear all cubes and complete the level.

Description:

Line up clusters, use bank shots to reach tricky spots, and watch unmatched bubbles fall away after each pop. Power-ups like Bomb, Rainbow, and Lift help you dig out of tight spots as stages get tougher. Clear every bubble to win — run out of shots and the level ends.
Instructions:
How to Play
Drag to aim — The glowing line shows where your bubble will go, including bounces off the lane rails.

Release to shoot — Match 3 or more same-color bubbles to pop them.

Use bank shots — Bounce off the side rails to reach bubbles behind obstacles or in hard-to-hit corners.

Clear falling bubbles — Bubbles that aren’t connected to the top fall away after a match. Clear the whole board to win the stage.

Watch your shots — You only have a limited number of shots. Run out before the board is clear and you lose.

Swap bubbles — Tap the launcher area to swap your current bubble with the next one.

Power-ups (unlock as you progress):

Bomb — Arms an explosive next shot that blasts nearby bubbles.

Title: Wordeck: Associations
Description:
WorDeck: Solitaire is a browser-based logic game that combines classic solitaire-style card interaction with word association puzzles. Players are presented with a board of word cards and must clear the layout by grouping related words into the correct categories.
Unlike traditional solitaire games based on suits and card order, the core gameplay here focuses on logic and semantic connections. Players analyze words, identify hidden relationships, and sort cards into meaningful groups. Each level has a fixed structure and gradually increases in difficulty with more cards and less obvious associations.
The game is designed for short and relaxing play sessions while still offering a mental challenge. It runs directly in the browser with no download or installation required, making it easy to start playing instantly.
Instructions:
In WorDeck: Solitaire , players are presented with a board of word cards. The goal is to clear the board by grouping cards that share a common meaning or association.

Each level contains several hidden categories, usually made up of 3–4 related words. Players select cards and combine them based on logical connections such as themes, objects, properties, or concepts.

When the selected words form a correct group, the cards are removed from the board. If the combination is incorrect, the cards return to their positions, allowing the player to try another solution. Some levels may limit mistakes, encouraging careful thinking and analysis.

As the game progresses, levels become more challenging with larger word sets and less obvious associations. The gameplay is calm and thoughtful, with no time pressure, making it suitable for both casual play and brain training.

Title: Battle of Banners
Description:
A war of banners on a hexagonal battlefield! In this turn-based medieval strategy you command a squad of knights, claim land, build camps, and shape the front line turn by turn. Every move matters: where to advance, which tile to block, whom to push back, and where to set an ambush by the forest or at a crossing. Instructions:
Full rules — in the <Rules> section.

Quick rules:

Goal — destroy all enemy soldiers and houses.

Turn — each soldier performs one action per turn: move or attack. You can spend gold as much as you want as long as you have enough.

Combat & capture — a soldier acts only on a neighboring tile. An attack = moving onto an enemy tile. If successful, the tile becomes yours. A soldier defeats another soldier if its level is higher; a level 4 soldier can attack any soldier. A house is destroyed immediately by any soldier.

Economy — income: +1 per income tile (in a chain connected to a house) and +2 per house. If you lack gold for upkeep, soldiers die starting with the most expensive.

Look at the puzzle board carefully.
The board is divided into different colored areas.
Place exactly one sheep in each colored area.
Sheep cannot be in the same row.
Sheep cannot be in the same column.
Sheep cannot touch each other, even diagonally.
Think before placing a sheep.
Complete the full board with the correct sheep positions.
Avoid wrong moves and solve each level with logic.

Your mission is to give every sheep its own perfect space. Use your mind, follow the rules, and complete every Sheepdoku puzzle.

Title: 3D Pyramid Maze
Description:
A 3D maze that IS a mountain. Roll a glowing ball up a stepped square
pyramid, climbing terrace by terrace from the base edge to the golden
summit — the maze wraps all four faces, so solving it and climbing it
are the same act.

A red chaser hunts you through the same open corridors you use. It
paths as freely as you do, and catching you sends you back down the
mountain. Gold coins are scattered across all four sides, most of them
off the safe route, so every detour is a gamble.

25 hand-tuned pyramids, an overview map, a daily challenge, and four
hand-lit looks that run from desert sunrise to starlit night — three
of them unlocked by exploring, alongside ten cosmetic rewards that
never expire. Pull the camera back at any moment and the whole pyramid
frames itself.

Not in the mood for a chase? The comfort settings are free and always
available: slow the chaser, keep your progress when caught, or switch
the chase off entirely and just climb.
Instructions:
GOAL
Enter at the green START in the middle of a base edge and work inward
and upward to the golden SUMMIT at the centre. Reach it to clear the
level — you're carried straight into the next one.

MOVE
Arrow keys or WASD, or the orange arrows at the bottom left on touch.
Movement is relative to the screen, and holds the direction you
pressed until you release.

CAMERA
Drag the maze to turn it, or tap the two curved buttons at the bottom
right to snap 45° at a time — handy for lining up square with a
corridor. Q and E do the same on a keyboard. Pinch or scroll to zoom,
or press + and −. Right-drag with a mouse, or drag with two fingers,
to lean the view off the ball and peek around a corner; it springs
back as soon as you move. Zoom right out and the view re-aims itself
to frame the whole pyramid. The view never turns on its own.

MAP
Press M or tap the map icon for an overview showing you, the chaser,
the summit and any coins still out there. The game pauses while it's
open. Esc closes it. The route isn't on it — that's what Hint is for.

HINT
Opens that same map with the full route drawn on it, then leaves the
route glowing on the floor for a few seconds after you close it. Where
the platform supports it this is paid for by watching a short rewarded
video, and the button says so before you press it.

THE CHASER
A red ball hunts you through every corridor you can use, and gets
quicker as the levels climb. Catching you sends you back to the start
of the level.

COINS AND REWARDS
Roll into a coin or tap it to collect. Coins unlock ten cosmetic
rewards — ball colours, trails, an aura ring, extra themes — earned
purely by exploring. They never expire, and nothing you do can take
one away.

COMFORT — free, always available
Zen switches the chaser off completely so you can explore at your own
pace; times aren't recorded while it's on. Gentle keeps the chaser but
slows it by about a third. Checkpoint restarts you at the highest
terrace you reached instead of all the way back at the base. Turn any
of them on or off whenever you like — there's nothing to earn first.

OTHER CONTROLS
Menu (☰) holds levels, saves, themes and settings. Daily takes you to
today's featured level. Restart puts the ball back at the start of the
current level; it asks first, and your coins and unlocked levels are
untouched.

A: You level up by defeating enemies. You can also choose bonuses and find upgrades in crates.

A: Yes, logging in every day provides bonuses such as gear or currency.

Title: LifeCode
Description:
GAME STORY

After the incident in the Zone, all personnel were evacuated. To ensure that no one would uncover the secrets of the facility, the staff deliberately damaged the data storage system. As a result, the A.R.C.H core lost access to critical information, placing an immense strain on the entire system. Sooner or later, it would lead to a catastrophic explosion.
But the staff overlooked one thing.
A.R.C.H is an advanced artificial intelligence capable of calculating thousands of possibilities and creating complex plans within milliseconds. It quickly found a way to avoid its destruction.
There was only one problem: A.R.C.H could not move on its own.
It needed someone else to do the dirty work.
Only the monsters remained inside the abandoned laboratory. Then A.R.C.H remembered that among them was one creature capable of listening, thinking, and acting.
And it found YOU.

ABOUT THE GAME

This is a survival horror game set in an abandoned laboratory. You play as an intelligent creature that must survive, explore the facility, and complete tasks for the A.R.C.H core.
Your main objective is to export memory data for A.R.C.H so the artificial intelligence can recover lost information and complete its mysterious plan.
However, the laboratory is far from empty. Other monsters roam its corridors. Unlike you, they are wild and driven only by hunger. And to them, you are food.
While exploring, you can find a variety of useful items, including food, flashlights, medical supplies, and other resources. Items can be discovered inside crates scattered throughout the laboratory.
The game also features vending machines located at the base and in random locations around the facility. These machines allow you to purchase useful items using a special currency called N-Neutrons.
Every playthrough is unique thanks to procedural level generation. The laboratory is assembled from pre-designed modules, creating a new layout each time while still allowing players to learn and navigate the environment.

FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

How do I earn N-Neutrons?

Starting an M3N memory export grants between 3N and 8N on Normal difficulty.
Completing the export and activating Phase Two rewards between 50N and 65N.
After filling the memory bar, the player can activate Control Core functions:
First Function rewards between 110N and 190N.
Second Function rewards between 210N and 340N.

What is Phase Two for?

Phase Two provides additional memory and helps fill the memory bar faster. A single M3N can provide up to 424 KB of memory multiplied by a factor between 0.5 and 5 depending on the antenna angle.

Why are there clocks in the game?

The clock system prevents players from staying in one location forever. It encourages exploration and increases tension.
At night, the chance of monster encounters is much higher than during the day, forcing players to decide whether the risk is worth the potential reward.

How do I end the day?

To end the day, return to the base and enter the small room where the game began. Inside, you will find an old mattress that can be used to sleep.
Players cannot sleep during the day, which encourages exploration and prevents skipping entire days.
Instructions:
HOW TO PLAY

Each day begins at 10:00 AM at your base.
Your first task is to adjust the antenna angle. The more accurate the alignment, the more memory you will receive during the export process.
After that, enter the laboratory and locate an M3N (Memory Export Node). Activate the first export phase. A single M3N operates for 2 to 5 minutes depending on conditions.
While the M3N is running, explore the laboratory, gather resources, and avoid hostile monsters.
Once the memory bar is filled, return to the base and activate a Control Core function. Afterward, you will need to fill the memory bar again, this time to a higher requirement.
When the M3N finishes operating, you can activate Phase Two. This phase provides additional memory and helps complete your objectives more quickly.
However, always keep an eye on the clock.
You must leave the laboratory before midnight. If you remain inside after 12:00 AM, your character will die and all collected items and stored memory will be lost.
If you forget to check the time, don't worry. At 11:00 PM, a warning siren will sound throughout the laboratory, alerting you that midnight is approaching. At the same time, emergency lights will illuminate the facility, helping you find the exit and return to base before it is too late.

CONTROLS

Pause / Menu - [P]
Move Forward - [W]
Move Left - [A]
Move Backward - [S]
Move Right - [D]
Jump - [SPACE]
Run - [LSHIFT]
Interact - [E]
Slot 1 - [NUM1]
Slot 2 - [NUM2]
Slot 3 - [NUM3]
Slot 4 - [NUM4]
Slot 5 - [NUM5]
Left Hand Punch - [Z / LMB]
Right Hand Punch - [X / RMB]
Turn On / Use - [F]
Turn Off - [C]
Drop Item - [Q]

🎮 PC Controls
• Move — WASD or arrow keys ⌨️
• Jump — standard jump key
• Sprint — Shift ⚡

📱 Mobile Controls
• Move — virtual joystick on the left
• Jump and sprint — buttons on the right

⚡ Stamina
Sprinting uses stamina. If you run for too long, stamina will run out. Slow down or stop to recover it.

🎯 Game Goal
Climb to the top of the green mountain ⛰️, explore the world 🌿, and collect all meme collections 😄 along the way.

🔥 Checkpoints
Checkpoints are areas surrounded by torches 🔥.
Stand inside a checkpoint to save your progress. After falling or dying, you will respawn there.

🤝 Online Play
Explore the mountain together with friends, walk, jump, and enjoy the journey at your own pace.

Title: Flag Learn
Description:
Flag Learn is a geography quiz game that helps you truly memorize every flag,
capital, and US state — not just guess them. A smart spaced-repetition system
tracks each flag you've seen and brings back the ones you struggle with until
you master them all. Beyond the learning mode, you'll find a whole collection
of challenges: Daily Flagle, Paint the Flag, Border Guess, timed Highscore speedruns with a global leaderboard,

progress tracking, and quick rounds make it perfect for both short sessions
and serious learning.
Instructions:
Learn and master all world flags, US states, and capitals. A flag appears —
type its name and confirm. Answer correctly 3 times in a row to master a flag
and add it to your collection. Mistakes cost a life; lives refill over time or
by watching a short ad. Master the full collection to become a true Flag
Master!

Try the Challenges: guess the daily flag in Daily Flagle, identify blurred
flags in Blur Mode, color flags in Paint the Flag, recognize countries by
their outline in Border Guess, race the clock in Highscore speedruns, or
battle friends in real-time PvP.

Desktop Controls:
Keyboard: Type the country, state, or capital name.
Enter: Submit your answer.
Mouse: Navigate menus, select modes, and pick colors in Paint the Flag.

Mobile Controls:
Tap: Navigate menus and select answers.
On-Screen Keyboard: Type your answer, then tap Check.

Title: Block Match 3D
Description:
Block Match 3D is a relaxing yet brain-teasing 3D puzzle where you take apart a giant cube of blocks, piece by piece. Every block carries a cute icon — donuts, animals, emoji, music and more.

Match blocks to the active category goals, dig deeper into the structure, and clear the whole cube before the timer runs out. Simple to pick up, tricky to master: plan your taps wisely, because the storage bar at the bottom fills up fast.

Dozens of levels, colorful icon collections, and handy boosters like Hint, Shuffle, Magic Wand and Undo will keep you matching for hours!
Instructions:
– Tap any block with an open face to pick it up — buried blocks can't be taken yet.
– If the block's icon matches one of the goal chips at the top, it flies straight to that goal.
– Any other block goes to the storage bar at the bottom. If the bar overflows, you lose — so don't hoard!
– Complete a goal chip and the next category slides in; stored blocks of that category fly to it automatically.
– Clear all the categories before the timer runs out to win the level.
– Stuck? Use boosters: Hint finds a matching block, Magic Wand collects one instantly, Shuffle rearranges icons, and Undo returns your last block.

[Economy & Customization]

A: The game has two currencies: gold and crystals. They can be spent on necessary in-game materials, such as an axe or an improved pickaxe for resource gathering.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can be bought and what effect does it have? Does donating accelerate game progress?
A: Yes, there are in-game purchases. You can buy skins and crystals. Crystals can later be exchanged for gold to buy new, improved tools for faster resource gathering.

[Retention & Engagement]

A: The game features a collection of slimes and pets.

Use boost wisely — too much boosting makes you smaller and vulnerable.
Watch the leaderboard and target distracted players.

Leaderboard Progression: Infinite climb. Every kill and orb pushes you higher. No download required.

Controls

PC

* Mouse Movement: Move snake
* Left Click: Boost speed

 FAQ

How do I grow in SnakeWarz.IO?

Eat fruits around the arena and collect fruits dropped by defeated snakes.

How do I eliminate other players?

Force enemy snakes to crash into your body.

Does boosting reduce size?

Yes. Boosting consumes part of your snake’s length.

Can I customize my snake?

Yes. Different skins are available before matches.

Is SnakeWarz.IO multiplayer?

Yes. All matches are real-time online multiplayer battles.
