Description:
Welcome to Arklet - a cozy and meditative puzzle game where your talent for organizing turns into the art of creating harmony for the most adorable creatures.

In this game, you become the caretaker of a unique ARKlet filled with charming "square" animals, each possessing its own personality, quirks, and little secrets.

🧩 Gameplay: Harmony in Every Block
Your task is simple: distribute the arriving animals into cozy rooms. However, each ward is an individual. To complete a level perfectly, you must do more than just fill the space; you must ensure every animal feels completely safe and comfortable.

🐾 Consider Every Detail:
Fears and Dislikes: A massive elephant might panic if placed in the same room as a tiny mouse. You will need to plan layouts so the giant doesn't even catch a glimpse of its small neighbor.
Friendship and Socializing: Some animals, like meerkats or raccoons, love company, while bears or porcupines might prefer solitude in a far corner. (some of the pets are still WIP)

A Meditative Pace: There are no stress-inducing timers. You can rearrange room blocks endlessly until you find the perfect combination.
Visual Delight: Watch fun animations - from a trembling, frightened elephant to a happy mouse munching on cheese.
Progressive Growth: Gradually build up your zoo, unlocking new locations ranging from sunny piers to icy icebergs. (WIP)

🧠 Who is this game for?
I made Arklet for fans of organization games and spatial puzzles. It is a project for those who want to unwind after a long day and immerse themselves in a world where everything can be put in its place, and the only reward that matters is the happy smile of a square animal.

Create a perfect sanctuary where even the most diverse animals can live in peace and harmony!

Title: Doodle Halloween Momo Cat : Academy
Description:
I, English:

Magic Cat Academy is a fun and adorable adventure game where you play as Momo the magic cat, a brave little student with big powers! One spooky night, silly ghosts sneak into her school and steal the magic book. Now it’s up to Momo to save the day!

To help Momo, players draw simple shapes on the screen to cast magic spells and pop the ghosts away. Each level takes you to a new part of the school, like the classroom, cafeteria, and even the rooftop. The ghosts get quicker and trickier, but with fast hands and sharp eyes, you can beat them all!

With cute characters, colorful animations, and easy touch controls, Magic Cat Academy is a safe, exciting, and kid-friendly game that’s perfect for players of all ages.

Help the lovely Momo Magic Cat cast out mischievous spirits by swiping in the shape of the symbols above the ghosts’ heads. And you’d better pounce fast—the ghost that stole the Arcane Magic spellbook is getting away! The school and all arcane magic are depended on your actions.

PURR-ify Ghost and Ghouls with your Arcane Magic. Swipe your magic wand to cast magic and save the Halloween.

II, Russian:

Magic Cat Academy — это весёлая и очаровательная приключенческая игра, в которой вы играете за Момо, волшебную кошечку, отважную маленькую ученицу с огромными способностями! Однажды жуткой ночью глупые призраки пробираются в её школу и крадут волшебную книгу. Теперь Момо предстоит спасти положение!

Чтобы помочь Момо, игроки рисуют на экране простые фигуры, чтобы колдовать и прогонять призраков. Каждый уровень переносит вас в новую часть школы, например, в класс, столовую и даже на крышу. Призраки становятся всё быстрее и хитрее, но с быстрыми руками и острым зрением вы сможете победить их всех!

С милыми персонажами, красочной анимацией и простым сенсорным управлением Magic Cat Academy — безопасная, увлекательная и дружелюбная для детей игра, идеально подходящая для игроков всех возрастов.

Помогите очаровательной волшебной кошечке Момо изгнать злых духов, проводя по символам над головами призраков. И поторопитесь — призрак, укравший книгу заклинаний «Тайная магия», убегает! Школа и вся тайная магия зависят от ваших действий.

Замурлыкайте призраков и упырей своей тайной магией. Взмахните волшебной палочкой, чтобы наложить магию и спасти Хэллоуин.
Instructions:
I. English:
1, Basic controls & gameplay
To play, you use either your mouse (on desktop) or finger/touch input (on touchscreen) to draw symbols on the screen. 
Each ghost shows one or more symbols above its head; you must draw that symbol (or sequence of symbols) correctly to cast a spell and defeat that ghost. 
Symbols vary — simple lines, shapes like “V” or “ʌ,” maybe a lightning bolt, etc
2. What you need to do & how it plays out.
Ghosts approach; as soon as you see a symbol above them, draw the shape quickly to “zap” them with a spell before they hit Momo. 
As levels progress, ghosts come faster and in greater numbers — the challenge is both speed and accuracy. 
At the end of each stage (or at least the final one), there’s a boss ghost — often requiring drawing a long chain or repeated spells to beat it. 
3. Goal & Scoring
Your goal: survive through all five levels, defeat all ghosts (and bosses), and reclaim the spellbook.

II. Russian:
1. Основные элементы управления и игровой процесс
В игре вы рисуете символы на экране мышью (на компьютере) или пальцем/сенсорным вводом (на сенсорном экране).

Над головой каждого призрака отображается один или несколько символов; вам необходимо правильно нарисовать этот символ (или последовательность символов), чтобы наложить заклинание и победить призрака.

Символы могут быть разными — простые линии, фигуры, например, «V» или «ʌ», возможно, молния и т. д.
2. Что нужно делать и как это происходит.
Призраки приближаются; как только вы увидите над ними символ, быстро нарисуйте его, чтобы «убить» их заклинанием, прежде чем они поразят Момо.

По мере прохождения уровней призраки появляются всё быстрее и их становится всё больше — сложность заключается как в скорости, так и в точности.

В конце каждого уровня (или, по крайней мере, последнего) вас ждёт призрак-босс, для победы над которым часто требуется нарисовать длинную цепочку или использовать несколько заклинаний. 3. Цель и подсчёт очков
Ваша цель: выжить на всех пяти уровнях, победить всех призраков (и боссов) и вернуть книгу заклинаний.

Title: Far Orion: New worlds
Description:
The year is 2121. Technology has advanced far beyond the bounds of our wildest fantasies, but great progress demands great sacrifice... 
Explore other worlds in the search for treasure and limitless power! 
Command a team of brave heroes and lead your world to victory!  
Game features: 
- several dozen unique heroes and battle cards 
- dozens of missions on every world 
- no irritating ads 
- PvP arena 
- tower mode 
- clans and clan wars
[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do you need to do?
A: It's an action strategy game where you complete levels (missions) and fight enemies.

Q: Does the game have a storyline?
A: Yes, there is a story. It's a sci-fi setting in the year 2121 with advanced technology, but something went wrong, and the heroes want to save the world.

Q: What is the game's unique selling point? What can hook players?
A: There are many different heroes with an upgrade system, a large number of missions, a PvP arena, a leaderboard, and clan wars. You can also upgrade attack cards.

Q: What are the engaging content elements (weapons, vehicles, locations, skills, references to famous franchises, etc.)?
A: A huge variety of heroes, many different and interesting abilities for these heroes, an engaging story, clear objectives, and simple in-game mechanics.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: Are there bosses and how do they differ?
A: There are bosses throughout the storyline, and they differ in design, attack types, and HP amount.

Q: How exactly does progression work? What should you do to level up faster?
A: To level up faster, you need to play well to earn enough in-game currency. The game is easy to play.

Q: Are there mini-games within the main story? For example, 'match-three' puzzles within the strategy game.
A: No.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What are the currencies and what are they spent on (standard - gold, premium - crystals, etc.)?
A: Money is spent on upgrading heroes, upgrading cards, and buying hero cards to unlock them.

Q: Are there in-game purchases? What can you buy and what does it affect? Does spending money speed up game progress?
A: Yes, microtransactions will speed up game progress, as you can buy in-game currency with real money and spend that currency on upgrades and cards.

Q: Is there customization in the game? Can you customize a hero's appearance, location editor, vehicle tuning, etc.?
A: You can only upgrade the heroes' levels and abilities, which also changes their appearance.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there leaderboards? How do you get on them? What types are there (weekly, monthly, all-time, etc.)?
A: There are various leaderboards depending on the different game modes, as well as a clan leaderboard. You need to play and gain levels.

Q: Are there daily rewards or something similar that encourages the player to return?
A: Yes, logging into the game every day provides various bonuses: cards, chests, and in-game currency.

Q: Is it advisable to play with sound to better immerse yourself in the atmosphere, or will playing without sound cause difficulties?
A: The music is good and complements the game, but it is not essential for completing the game.

Q: Is there an achievement system? What are they and what can you get them for?
A: Achievements are awarded for daily logins, reaching a certain level in a specific mode, and completing certain objectives, such as collecting 6 heroes in total. Rewards include chests, in-game currency, and cards.
Instructions:
Gather a squad of heroes and a deck of cards and complete missions. 
Use the money you receive to unlock new heroes and upgrade your cards.  

Which heroes should I take into battle? 
- those that complement each other and are stronger together, like a healer and a tank.  
What cards should I fight with?
- those that can strengthen your squad of heroes, or basic cards for healing and damage to enemies
 How do I earn gold?
- by completing missions and daily quests, and fighting in the tower and the aren

♥ Just lay out your cards in ascending or descending order!

The better the alignment with the block below, the more of the block remains. If part of the block overhangs, the overhanging part is cut off.
If you drop with a slight misalignment, the excess portion is cut away and removed, making your next block smaller.
If your misalignment is very poor (i.e. almost no overlap), you might lose the block entirely, ending the game.
Each successful drop continues the tower upward. The goal is to stack as many as possible, reaching the highest possible height (score).
As the tower gets higher, it becomes more challenging. The blocks may move faster or require more precision. (This is common in stacking games of this type.)

Title: Lane Clash
Description: Lane Hold is a casual 3D lane-defense game. Hold your fortress across five parallel lanes: tap a lane shield to spawn warriors, clash power head-on, and stop enemies before they breach the wall. Clear short waves, upgrade lanes and the base between rounds, and use Shield, Bomb, and Freeze when the pressure rises — no joystick, no chasing camera, just tense lane battles.
Instructions:
Defend your fortress across five lanes. Enemies run toward your wall — tap a lane shield to spawn warriors (when cooldown is ready). When units clash, their power cancels out: the weaker is destroyed, the stronger keeps going with the leftover power. If an enemy reaches the wall, your base loses HP equal to that enemy’s power.

How to win
Clear each wave by defeating or blocking all enemies before your base HP drops to zero. Survive the wave to earn rewards, upgrade your lanes, and advance to the next wave.

Upgrades & items

Lane gears: upgrade tier and power with coins, cooldown with gems
Wall HP bar: base upgrades and repair
Inventory: Shield (arm a lane), Bomb (clear nearby enemies), Freeze (slow a lane)
Tap coins on the field to collect them
Ad Rewards: watch ads for gems and coins
Items shop (tap an empty inventory slot): buy items with gems; in-apps when payments are available

Controls

Mouse / touch: tap a lane shield to spawn
Inventory buttons: use Shield, Bomb, or Freeze during a wave
Continue: after a win
Soft Retry (watch an ad for an easier wave) or Back: after a defeat

Merge two basic-level animal bubbles to form an intermediate-level animal.

Winning the Level:
The level is completed when you have successfully created and collected the required number of final animals.

Title: Orbit Shift
Description:
You're locked in orbit around a dying star: two rings, two lanes, one chance. Tap to switch. Don't get hit. How long can you last?

Orbit Shift is a one-tap lane-switching endless space arcade game where reflexes are everything. Comets, shooting stars, and meteors spawn at the top of two concentric rings and spiral clockwise toward your ship. Your only move is shifting between the inner and outer ring — but timing that one move perfectly, over and over, faster and faster, is everything.

Each stage runs exactly one minute and escalates in speed and obstacle density, climaxing in a surge — a short, intense burst of rapid-fire obstacles that acts as a skill gate before the next stage unlocks. Difficulty pulses in waves: pressure builds to each surge, then briefly eases, before the next stage raises the floor. By Stage 5, gaps between hazards shrink to fractions of a second.

Survival time is your score, tracked against your personal best. No checkpoints. Every run starts from zero. You'll have to earn every second.

Cosmetics — trails, ships, and color schemes — unlock through achievements tied to real gameplay stats. All purely visual. No pay-to-win, no randomness. Play anywhere — no download required, instant play on desktop and mobile.

Orbit Shift is an original game handcrafted by cfc, a human game developer.
Instructions:
Dodge obstacles. Collect shield crystals. Survive as long as you can.

Tap, click, or press Space to instantly switch your ship between the inner and outer orbital rings. There is no cooldown or animation delay — the switch is immediate. Obstacles spawn at 12 o'clock and rotate clockwise toward your ship at 6 o'clock on both rings. Your job is to read the pattern and keep switching to whichever ring is clear, timing each move to slip through the gaps as they come.

When a hazard is about to hit your ring, the ring itself flares red — a last-second visual danger warning. The best players are already on the safe ring before it lights up, but the flare is there to back you up when you lose track.

**Shield crystals** appear between the two rings. To collect one, you need to time a switch so your ship passes through it. Collect three crystals and your shield activates and lasts until you get hit, protecting you from the next hit before it shatters. A shield can save a great run, so collect crystals whenever it's safe to do so. However, crystals sometimes appear in tight spots between obstacles — if you're still learning the rhythm, it's better to skip a risky crystal than to mistiming the switch and die. Once your timing is sharp, those tight grabs become some of the most rewarding moments in the game.

**Strategy:** Don't react to the obstacle directly in front of you — read two or three ahead and queue your switches as a sequence. Frantic tapping kills runs; clean, deliberate timing carries you deep. Avoid panic-switching; commit to each move and trust the pattern.

**Stages and surges:** Each stage runs exactly 60 seconds and ends in a surge — a dense, fast onslaught where both rings glow red. Survive the surge and the next stage begins, faster than the last, with new obstacle patterns and a new color theme. The difficulty pulses in crescendos rather than climbing in a straight line, giving you a brief recovery window between surges before the pressure builds again.

**Controls:**
- Space bar / Tap / Click: Switch between inner and outer rings
- P: Pause (timer resumes on unpause)
- Tab / First letter: Navigate menus

Some levels have a long reach you have to make the ball roll. Instructions:
Desktop:
Use your mouse left click button to select on the screen & drag your mouse to rotate the cups.
Drag left or down to spin clockwise.
Drag right or up to spin counterclockwise.

Touchscreen devices:
Tap the screen with a finger & drag your finger across the screen to rotate cups clockwise or counterclockwise.

Instructions:
Objective: Sort all the mixed colored liquids so that each test tube holds exactly one solid color.

Controls:

Click or Tap on another tube to pour the liquid into it.

Rules:
You can only pour water on top of another liquid if they share the exact same color AND if the destination tube has enough empty space.

Title: Durak
Description:
Durak is essentially a shedding card game where each player will try to get rid of the cards in their hand first. Durak is quite an enjoyable game that has over the years made a general impact on millions. It is a game that requires critical thinking, which is why it is more popular among people who consider themselves tech-savvy.

The objective of Durak is to play all your cards. The loser in Durak will be the last player with cards in their hand. So, to ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can.

Durak is the most popular Russian card game. Durak means fool and it refers to the person who loses the game.

A Durak card game is one of the easiest and most fun card games. Players do not need much to get started. You will only need: a poker deck reduced to 36 cards from Ace to 6.

However, this game is quite interesting because there will usually be multiple winners. To ensure you do not lose, try to act fast and get rid of your cards as soon as you can.


Durak might not be a game you are overly familiar with. But in Russia, Durak is by far the most popular card game! It has got a fascinating history and will be sure to make a unique choice if you are looking for something a little different.

Another interesting thing about this game is that it is played with a smaller deck.

Durak is fun and, rather, a unique card game. If you enjoy more strategic card games and are looking for something a little different, why not give Durak a try?
Instructions:
Durak is played by 2 to 4 players. Total cards used are 36 cards - Only 6 7 8 9 10 J Q K A of all suits are used.

The deck is shuffled, and each player is dealt with 6 cards. The bottom card of the stock is turned and placed face up on the table. The rest of the pack is then placed on half over the turn-up and at right angles to it, so that it remains visible. The trump suit is drawn as the last card.

The first person to play is the one who holds the lowest trump suit in his hand. The game proceeds in a clockwise direction. The player who started to play acts as an attacker and the player sitting next to him in a clockwise direction acts as a defender.

The player who has the lowest trump card will be the first attacker. If the attack succeeds, the defender loses their turn, and the attack passes to the player on the defender's left. If the attack fails, the defender becomes the next attacker. The attacker opens their turn by playing a card face up on the table as an attacking card. Defender responds to the attack with a defending card. A trump card of any rank beats all cards in the other three suits

To win Durak, you need to play all your cards quickly. Once you have played your cards, you are out of the game and will need to wait for the rest of the players. The last player with cards in their hand loses.

Collect special icons (magnet, x2, freeze, etc.) to power up the ball or alter sticker behavior. For example, "Ghost" lets the ball pass through triggers, while "Double Move" grants a second strike without new stickers appearing.

5. Buying Packs:
Before your first turn, choose a free Level 1 pack. Each pack contains 100 stickers, with 10 appearing per turn.

6. Strategy Tips:
Use "Freeze" or "Bonus" to increase the number of stickers on the field.
Combine triggers like "Magnet" + "x2" for double rewards.
Prioritize Holo-stickers - they grant x2 coins!

[Core Gameplay & Story]

Q: What is the game about? What do players do?
A: This is an idle tycoon game set in a magical academy. You build and upgrade various facilities, train students, and generate profits.

Q: What is the game's hook? What makes it stand out to players?
A: The game features a polished, beautiful design along with various features like daily quests, tasks, and achievements to keep players engaged.

[Mechanics & Progression]

Q: How does the progression system work? What can be done to level up faster?
A: Success requires strategic thinking to upgrade the right functions and academy facilities. This increases your profit, which can then be reinvested into further upgrades.

[Economy & Customization]

Q: What currencies are available and what can they be spent on?
A: Gold coins are used for upgrading academy facilities and expanding features, such as adding more student slots, increasing training speed, and improving the quality of education. Diamonds can also be purchased to speed up construction.

Q: Are there in-app purchases? What can players buy, and how do they affect gameplay?
A: Yes, players can purchase diamonds and an option to remove ads to speed up their progress.

[Retention & Engagement]

Q: Are there daily rewards or similar mechanics to encourage player return?
A: There are daily rewards as well as free hourly chests that contain mages or in-game currency.

Q: Is it recommended to play with sound for immersion, or will players face difficulties without it?
A: The sound design is high-quality, but it is not required to progress in the game.

Title: Sort It Out: Category Sort
Description:
A fast-paced, head-to-head card sorting game. Cards are stacked on a wooden tabletop grid, each showing an emoji or icon (animals, food, tech, sports, and more). You race a rival to sort cards into the right category slots before the clock runs out.
Each match is a 90-second duel. You and your opponent share the same kind of puzzle: stacks of mixed cards and gold goal slots labeled with categories like Animals, Food, or Tech. Whoever completes the most full categories when time expires wins.
Instructions:
Complete more categories than your rival before the timer hits zero.

Each completed category counts as 1 point. Ties go to you.

The Board
A 5×4 grid of cells on a wooden table.
Some cells are gold category goal slots (e.g. “Animals 0/6”) — drop matching cards here.
Other cells hold stacks of cards — only the top card of each stack can be grabbed.
A shelf of 5 free slots runs along the bottom for temporary storage.
Each match uses 3 categories, with 5–7 cards per category depending on difficulty.

Controls
Drag a card — grab the top card from any stack (or from the shelf).
Drop it on the matching category slot — e.g. a dog card goes on the Animals goal.
Wrong category? The card is rejected and snaps back.
Use the shelf — drag a top card to an empty shelf slot to reach the card underneath in that stack.
Empty grid cells — you can also place a card on a blank grid cell as a holding spot.

Title: Tile Harvest 3D
Description: Tile Harvest 3D is a 3D tile-matching puzzle game with a satisfying merge twist. Clear a towering stack of colorful 3D tiles by collecting matching sets and chaining them into powerful merges. With unlimited levels, escalating challenge, and a set of special boosters to save you in a pinch, every puzzle is a fresh brain-teaser.
Instructions:
Your goal: Clear every tile from the 3D board to win the level.

1. Pick matching tiles
Tap any accessible tile on the 3D stack. When you tap 3 tiles of the same type, they are collected and sent to your Factory Belt — a row of slots at the bottom of the screen.

2. Watch your Factory Belt
The Factory Belt holds the tiles you've collected. When 3 identical items sit in the belt at the same time they automatically merge into a brand-new, higher-tier item — clearing those slots and making room for more.

3. Rotate & zoom the board
The tiles are stacked in 3D. Swipe to rotate the board and expose hidden tiles underneath. Pinch to zoom in or out. Uncovering the right tiles at the right time is the key to a clean chain of merges.

4. Don't run out of space
If your Factory Belt fills up with tiles that can't merge, you're stuck — and the level is lost. Think ahead, plan your picks, and keep the belt flowing.

5. Use boosters wisely
Four boosters help you out of tight spots:

🔄 Throwback — Send the last tile in the belt back to the board.
🌀 Whirlwind — Shuffle the tiles on the board for a fresh look.
🔍 Magnifier — Highlights a set of 3 matching tiles for you.
🔨 Hammer — Smash and remove a single tile from the board.

II, Russian:
🎃 Magic Cat Academy 2 – Подводное Хэллоуин-приключение

В этой весёлой и немного таинственной игре от Google на Хэллоуин вы играете за Момо — храброго волшебного котёнка, который отправляется в подводный мир, чтобы защитить морских жителей и остановить непослушных призраков! 🌊🐱👻

После событий первой игры Момо снова вступает в бой — только теперь под водой! Призраки спрятались в разных морских существах, и вам нужно помочь Момо прогнать их. Чтобы победить призраков, рисуйте простые фигурки на экране, и котёнок наложит заклинание, чтобы очистить море. ✨

✨ Что делает игру интересной

Вы исследуете глубины океана, где в морских обитателях прячутся призраки — медузы, рыбы-удильщики и другие.

Над каждым призраком появляется символ, и вам нужно быстро нарисовать его, чтобы победить врага.

Чем дальше вы играете, тем веселее и сложнее становится приключение!

🐾 Почему детям нравится эта игра

Красочный подводный мир 🌈

Забавные персонажи и милые призраки 👻

Простое управление — рисуй и побеждай ✨

Отлично подходит для тех, кто любит магию и приключения!
Instructions:
I. English:
1, Basic controls & gameplay
To play, you use either your mouse (on desktop) or finger/touch input (on touchscreen) to draw symbols on the screen. 
Each ghost shows one or more symbols above its head; you must draw that symbol (or sequence of symbols) correctly to cast a spell and defeat that ghost. 
Symbols vary — simple lines, shapes like “V” or “ʌ,” maybe a lightning bolt, etc
2. What you need to do & how it plays out.
Ghosts approach; as soon as you see a symbol above them, draw the shape quickly to “zap” them with a spell before they hit Momo. 
As levels progress, ghosts come faster and in greater numbers — the challenge is both speed and accuracy. 
At the end of each stage (or at least the final one), there’s a boss ghost — often requiring drawing a long chain or repeated spells to beat it. 
3. Goal & Scoring
Your goal: survive through all five levels, defeat all ghosts (and bosses), and save the ocean.

II. Russian:
1. Основные элементы управления и игровой процесс
В игре вы рисуете символы на экране мышью (на компьютере) или пальцем/сенсорным вводом (на сенсорном экране).

Над головой каждого призрака отображается один или несколько символов; вам необходимо правильно нарисовать этот символ (или последовательность символов), чтобы наложить заклинание и победить призрака.

Символы могут быть разными — простые линии, фигуры, например, «V» или «ʌ», возможно, молния и т. д.
2. Что нужно делать и как это происходит.
Призраки приближаются; как только вы увидите над ними символ, быстро нарисуйте его, чтобы «убить» их заклинанием, прежде чем они поразят Момо.

По мере прохождения уровней призраки появляются всё быстрее и их становится всё больше — сложность заключается как в скорости, так и в точности.

В конце каждого уровня (или, по крайней мере, последнего) вас ждёт призрак-босс, для победы над которым часто требуется нарисовать длинную цепочку или использовать несколько заклинаний. 
3. Цель и подсчёт очков
Ваша цель: выжить на всех пяти уровнях, победить всех призраков (и боссов) и спасти океан.

Use Undo before spending a Hint.
Instructions:

Clear all stacks to finish the level.

Undo — Take back your last move if you played the wrong card.
Hint — Highlights the best next move when you're stuck.
Key — Unlocks a sealed stack, flipping hidden cards face-up so you can play them.

Title: Zombie Merge
Description:
A top-down survival duel. You’re pinned at the center of the arena while a horde of zombies pours in from the edges. Your rival survivor is doing the same on their side of the match — you’re racing to outscore them before the 90-second clock runs out.

The twist is the merge mechanic: killing a zombie doesn’t always remove it from the field. Below max tier, it fuses into another zombie of the same type, upgrading it into something bigger, slower, tankier, and worth more points. Only the top-tier Colossus (Lv 5) dies for good. The better you play, the more dangerous the horde becomes — but also the more points you can farm.
Instructions:
How to Play
Goal
Score more points than your rival before time runs out. If your health hits zero, you’re eaten — the rival keeps scoring until the clock ends, and ties go to them.

Controls
You stay fixed in the center — you don’t move around the map.
Your gun auto-fires at zombies inside its forward fire cone (~94° arc).
Click/touch and drag anywhere on screen to swing the gun and aim manually.
Release to return to auto-aim.
Zombies behind you are outside your gun’s cone — they won’t get shot unless you turn toward them, but they can still bite you.

Spinning saws guard some rungs
Wood boards block half the lane (with a gap you must fly through)
Other obstacles appear at higher heights: slanted beams, diamonds, moving pills, stone blocks, spinning wheels
Golden eggs float along flight paths as bonus pickups. Your main score is height in meters — how high you’ve climbed. A simulated rival chicken climbs alongside you, gaining meters over time.

Each match lasts 90 seconds. Win by ending with more meters than your rival. If you die mid-match, your score freezes at your peak height and the match ends shortly after; you still win if you’re ahead.

Outside matches you can earn coins and rank points (RP), unlock cosmetics, and play Quick Match or the Coop Climb ladder (5 rivals in a row).
Instructions:
Core loop
Start on a rung in the barn.
Drag backward from the chicken to stretch its wings (slingshot tension).
Release to launch upward.
Land on the next peg to stop and sling again.
Repeat to climb higher.
Collect golden eggs by flying through them (shown as coin pickups in the HUD).
Avoid hazards — especially spinning saws and solid obstacle hits.

Levels in the Survival game mode are unlocked as you progress through the main Campaign.

Kinetic Puzzle is a block and grid puzzle brain teaser. Blocks slide with momentum until they hit a wall, an obstacle, or another block. Drag them out through edge portals — but only if the order, direction, and dependencies line up.

Master four block types:
- Red simple — slides any direction, exits any portal.
- Yellow constrained — only moves and exits in its arrow direction.
- Blue dependent — locked until its prerequisite block leaves the board.
- Gray obstacle — fixed walls that block momentum.

Features:
- 50++ hand-crafted levels, ramping from gentle slides to multi-step dependency chains
- Slide momentum mechanics — every push counts
- Neo-brutalism art style with chunky tiles and tactile feedback
- No timers, no ads mid-puzzle
- Auto-save progress, undo, and hint support
- Plays great on mobile, tablet, and desktop
- Perfect for puzzle fans who like to think before they move.
Instructions:
Goal
Remove every red, yellow, and blue block from the board through the orange edge portals. Gray obstacle blocks stay where they are.
Movement rule
Blocks slide with momentum: they keep going in the swiped direction until they hit a wall, an obstacle, or another block. To exit, line a block up with a portal and slide toward it.

Desktop controls
- Mouse swipe: click and drag a block in a cardinal direction (up / down / left / right), then release. The block slides until it hits something.
- Drag-to-exit: drag a block past the board edge through an aligned portal to remove it.
- Undo / Hint / Restart / Pause: bottom and top HUD buttons.

Mobile / touch controls
- Swipe: touch a block, swipe in a cardinal direction, release. Same momentum rule applies.
- Drag-to-exit: hold a block and drag it past the edge through a portal to remove.
- Tap: HUD buttons (undo, hint, restart, pause) all tap-friendly.

Title: Emoji Memory: Find a Pair
Description:
You need to turn over the cards, trying to find pairs of identical ones.

If two different cards are turned over, they are automatically turned back over, giving the player a little time to memorize them.

The level will be completed when the player opens all pairs of cards in the playing field.

There are two additional game modes in which you can set records by competing with other players: for time and for the minimum number of moves.
Instructions:
Click on any inverted card with the mouse or your finger on the touchscreen to open it.

When a player has unfolded two cards, the player is credited with opening one pair of cards if they turn out to be the same. And if the cards turn out to be different, then they will turn back over.

After that, you can open the following cards.

Jigmerge Puzzles is perfect for players who enjoy relaxing experiences, visual challenges and the satisfying moment when everything falls into place. Instructions: Drag tiles to restore the picture. When two matching fragments touch, they automatically merge. Merged groups can be moved as one. Complete the full image to finish the level and unlock the next puzzle.

Instructions:

Clear the Board: Group all keywords into their respective category piles using your limited pool of moves to win the level!

Title: Drone Dash - Time Challenges!
Description:
**How to Play**

Welcome to **Drone Dash - Time Challenges** – a fast-paced arcade puzzler where quick thinking and precision bouncing are the keys to victory! You’ll control a zippy little drone that *dashes* between walls and platforms like a high-tech pinball. But this isn’t your typical platformer – no jumping, no gravity drops. Your drone glides and ricochets from surface to surface, smoothly darting through tight spaces full of traps and twists.

Your mission? **Collect as many bullets as you can before time runs out!** The more you grab, the more stars you’ll earn (up to 3 per level). Once you collect the minimum required, a glowing crystal spawns back at your starting point – reach it to complete the level. But watch out! Hit a trap or run out of time, and it's back to the start.

Levels are short, intense, and packed with surprises. New traps and tricky tiles will keep you on your toes as you dash your way to perfection. Fast reflexes and smart movement make all the difference!

**Controls:**
🖱️ On PC: Just click to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice!
📱 On Mobile: Just tap to bounce your drone in the direction of your choice!

Ready to test your reflexes and grab those stars? Dive into the dash and beat the clock!

Title: Electron dash
Description:
Attract. Repel. Survive.

Master the invisible forces of physics in this high speed magnetic arcade game. You do not just run, you glide, slam, and swing using the power of magnetism.

Use the polarity slider to instantly switch your charge between Red and Blue. Repel off walls to launch yourself across the map, or attract toward magnetic pillars to drift around tight corners.

Key Features:
Unique Control System: Master the polarity slider to push and pull your way to victory.

Physics Based Movement: Feel the momentum as you squish into walls and rocket through open spaces.
Instructions:
Feel the Pull!
Navigate complex mazes using nothing but the power of attraction and repulsion. Adjust your magnetic charge to fly through the air, dodge traps, and collect coins.

How to Control:
The Slider: This is your steering wheel found at the bottom of the screen.
Slide Left: Activates Negative Charge (Blue).
Slide Right: Activates Positive Charge (Red).
Let Go: Returns to Neutral (Momentum only).

Rules of Physics:
Opposites Attract: Positive pulls you toward Negative.
Likes Repel: Positive pushes you away from Positive. Use this to launch yourself!

Your Mission:

1. Collect all Coins.
2. Reach the Finish Zone safely.
3. Do it before the Timer runs out!

Instructions:

He can maximize his gameplay by catching bonuses, completing image puzzles, taking in-game world screenshots, or lighting exhibits to uncover their art contents, while getting a comfortable view of the outside scenery through large bay windows and enjoying a cosy or rhythmic music atmosphere.
He may also refine his strategy by prioritizing moving the ball forward to finish a level versus finishing puzzles or taking screenshots to earn extra lives and better score and level ranking.
He has to beware of maluses which will slow down his progression, but the good news is that these can actually turn to his advantage, e.g getting a chance to retrieve an extra life (in completing the missing blocks of a puzzle or hitting a final screenshot) or simply getting an easy way out with a downsized racket.

Desktop controls:

Menus:
mouse + click left to access menus/icons

In game:
mouse move: racket control up-down-left-right
click left: launch ball & move forward
P: pause/unpause game

Mobile controls:

Menus:
tap to access menus/icons

In game:
touch & move racket: racket control up-down-left-right
touch move icon: launch ball & move forward


Average time to complete a level using the "Save game" option is about 20 to 30min for beginners. 
"Save game" option allows the user to save the game at every Act end (3 Acts per level, 8 levels) and at every beginning of level ("Load game" to continue to play).
The player will be able to replay all levels which were previously completed (and saved) thanks to the 'Choose game level" menu.

A Training Room is accessible from the main menu. It explains the game principles/mechanics (but only partly to let the player discover by himself), shows an automatic demo and allows the player to test the game before entering Level 1.

Title: Clash of Skulls
Description:
Clash of Skulls is a tower defense game where you try to prevent enemies from destroying your base by deploying various types of units. Face a dangerous horde of evil creatures that intend to invade your lands. Combine and level up your units to have the upper hand and increase your damage output. Once you've taken care of the defense part, you can start planning your attacks to take over your enemy's territory. Hire skeleton warriors with blades, spears, scythes, explosives, battering rams, and much more... Go ahead and try it. Clash of Skulls rules!

This side-scrolling strategy game features a lane-based tug-of-war mechanic where players deploy diverse skeleton units to destroy the opponent's fortified tower. The gameplay loop centers on managing a regenerating mana resource to summon units from a card-based hand, including melee warriors, archers, and heavy-hitting bosses like the hog rider. Each unit automatically marches right toward the enemy base, engaging in combat upon contact. Victory is achieved by depleting the enemy tower's health bar displayed at the top of the screen. The visual style is a clean 2D cartoon aesthetic with flat vector graphics against a bright, tranquil backdrop of rolling green hills and blue skies. The color palette is dominated by vibrant greens, yellows, and blues, contrasting with the dark, gritty character designs of the skeletal army. A wooden HUD at the bottom tracks current mana and unit cooldowns, while the top UI displays player names and health bars. The tone is casual yet competitive, offering accessible pick-up-and-play mechanics suitable for a wide audience. Progression is indicated by an upgrade system accessible from the main menu, likely allowing players to strengthen their unit cards using earned currency to tackle more difficult bots or players.
Instructions:
Destroy the opponent tower base by deploying the skull warriors.

Desktop:
Use mouse click on cards to deploy units on the battlefield.

Mobile :
Use screen touch on cards to deploy units on the battlefield.

As you progress, the puzzles become more challenging and trickier. Placements will test your ability to think ahead and spot Connect-2 connections quickly. It’s not just about what you see - it’s about how you navigate the board to match the jewels.
